# megooflags_flag_environment (Resource)

A flag's targeting in one environment. Destroying it turns the flag off there and clears its targeting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "megooflags_flag_environment" "new_checkout_staging" {
  project     = megooflags_project.shop.key
  flag        = megooflags_flag.new_checkout.key
  environment = "staging"
  enabled     = true

  targets = [
    { variation = "true", values = ["alice", "bob"] },
  ]

  rules = [
    {
      description = "Beta testers"
      clauses = [
        { operator = "in_segment", values_json = jsonencode([megooflags_segment.beta.key]) },
      ]
      variation = "true"
    },
  ]

  # 25% of the other users get the new checkout.
  fallthrough = {
    rollout = {
      weights = [
        { variation = "true", weight = 25000 },
        { variation = "false", weight = 75000 },
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the flag is on in the environment.
- `environment` (String) Environment key. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `fallthrough` (Attributes) What is served when no target or rule matches. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fallthrough))
- `flag` (String) Flag key. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `project` (String) Project key. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `prerequisites` (Attributes List) Flags that must serve a variation before this flag is evaluated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prerequisites))
- `rules` (Attributes List) Rules, checked in order. A rule matches when all of its clauses match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `targets` (Attributes List) Context keys served a variation directly. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))

### Read-Only

- `version` (Number) Version of the configuration, raised on every change.

### Nested Schema for `fallthrough`

Optional:

- `rollout` (Attributes) Percentage rollout. Set this or variation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fallthrough--rollout))
- `variation` (String) Variation served. Set this or rollout.

<a id="nestedatt--fallthrough--rollout"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fallthrough.rollout`

Required:

- `weights` (Attributes List) Each variation's share in thousandths of a percent; they add up to 100000. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fallthrough--rollout--weights))

Optional:

- `bucket_by` (String) Context attribute hashed to pick a variation.

<a id="nestedatt--fallthrough--rollout--weights"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fallthrough.rollout.weights`

Required:

- `variation` (String) Variation key.
- `weight` (Number) Share, 1000 = 1%.

### Nested Schema for `rules.clauses`

Required:

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is <project>/<flag>/<environment>.
terraform import megooflags_flag_environment.new_checkout_staging shop/new-checkout/staging
```
